## Summary

Describe the problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

List the commands and scenarios used to validate the change.

## Security and privacy

Describe any effect on Microsoft Graph permissions, exported fields, identity data, or report retention. Write `None` when there is no impact.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and documented.
- [ ] The offline smoke test passes.
- [ ] PSScriptAnalyzer has no new warning or error findings.
- [ ] Test data is fictional and uses reserved domains such as `example.com`.
- [ ] No generated reports, tenant data, credentials, or access tokens are included.
- [ ] User-visible changes are reflected in the README and changelog where appropriate.
